Single CEA shadow-economy study PDF; benchmark evidence rather than a monitored feed.

Commercial country-risk page with only qualitative informal-economy framing; little added value for market statistics.

Archive CDX pattern to mine historical bank tariff/card-fee documents per domain; a harvesting recipe, not a live feed.
